richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Phusro

c: Phusro lies in the Bermo coalfield of Bokaro district, Jharkhand, close to the Damodar river, and much of the town lives in colliery colonies with their own grounds and community halls. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Phusro for these colonies, local schools, clubs and the civic body's open spaces. Each machine is made at our Vasai factory, about 1440 km away.

We dispatch to Jharkhand by road, and our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes the machines on site. The Chota Nagpur plateau has hot summers, a good monsoon from June and cool winters. Coal dust settles on everything in a mining town. Galvanised frames resist corrosion well, but regular wiping keeps the pivots and handles moving freely.

richText.heading: A colliery colony gym that is easy to look after

items.q: Does coal dust damage outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Dust does not harm the galvanised frame, but it can make bearings stiff over time. Wipe the moving parts every week and grease them as per the care sheet we share at handover.

items.q: Can a colliery colony committee place the order?
items.a: Yes. A committee, club, school or company can order. Share the ground size and photos, and we send a layout drawing with a quote for approval.

items.q: How long is the warranty on springs and bearings?
items.a: One year on springs, bearings and spare parts, and three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and maintained as instructed.
